verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of Elasticsearch's data retention or deletion controls (e.g., index lifecycle management, TTL, data tiers, delete-by-query, GDPR/right-to-erasure tooling) — all citations focus on search, vector/hybrid retrieval, serverless scaling, and MCP integration. Retention/deletion control is a fair and applicable axis for a data store product, but no supporting evidence exists in this pack.
